definitions.explanation: The back of the neck, where an animal or person can be grabbed. Used mostly in the idiom {首根|くびね}っこを{押|お}さえる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首根|くびね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ。
examples.english: To grab a cat by the scruff of the neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首根|くびね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえた→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: The guard grabbed the thief by the scruff of the neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大口|おおぐち}→大口：32012_ooguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{首根|くびね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえられている→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}れない→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
examples.english: Our biggest client has us over a barrel, so we can't refuse the price cut.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {首根|くびね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to hold someone down by the neck; to have someone in one's power
- {首根|くびね}っこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかむ: to grab by the scruff of the neck

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧: neck
- ⟦うなじ→うなじ：08541_unaji⟧: nape of the neck (neutral; also used in describing beauty)
